arms.U: Competent ordinary frontier-model research with tools; investigate the question and deliver four grounded candidates.
arms.E: Expert operation: map unmet outcomes and binding constraints; generate cross-domain connections; challenge obvious formulations and prior art; propose decisive constructions; reject weak commercial participation; return four grounded candidates.
arms.H_proxy: Same frontier model applies a conventional expert technology-opportunity search: literature/market gap map, feasibility and resource estimates, stakeholder needs and prior-art review. This is not a human trial.

selection: Root compares candidates against the frozen rubric, checks strongest prior art, and selects one for construction. Root evaluation is internal and unblinded to arm labels; no independent judging claim. Candidate generation occurs in fresh context with no access to other arms or completed studies.
